name: Ghost Pop
tagline: ghost-editor's pop: giant 900-weight display words around the speaker, hot pink, uppercase captions in a hot box.

motion.direction: ghost-editor `pop`. Giant display words (Archivo Black 900, line-height 0.86, letter-spacing −6 px, UPPERCASE) framing the speaker — in the source they sit behind the head via a matte; here keep them above and beside the head, never over the face. Captions uppercase on a hot pink `ter` box, 1–3 words. Slams (scale 1.5 → 1 in 0.16 s back.out 2.6), alternating ±2 / −3° rotation, shake steps 0.03 s; `stamp` verdicts; `counter` punches; whip pans. Beats 1.8–2.5 s; one card + one reaction at a time.
